config.registration: Freeze direct-difference grids before evaluating this campaign; retain all 54 cards, three distances and both thicknesses.
config.metric: max(norm(response_a-response_b)/fixed_full_force_scale) divided by max(norm(response_a)/fixed_full_force_scale); exact-zero cards checked separately.
config.scope: Sampled small-signal numerical convergence, not pointwise relative or uniform error bounds, observational detectability or physical source uncertainty.
config.baseline_comparison: Preserve old full-field subtraction as a diagnostic; do not require the inaccurate old tiny differences to match within a relative-signal tolerance.
